Barreletics Performance Skins are grippy shoes with 360° full-contact grip: not patches, not another disposable sock. current.studio_faq_2_a: Yes — engineered for reformer carriage load, Megaformer, Lagree, barre, hot Pilates, and yoga. The 360° grip handles lateral forces that destroy traditional Pilates socks and yoga socks. Both perform identically with the same grip and stability.

current.studio_faq_6_q: Closed Sole or Open Sole — which one?
